operational.name: Creative team
operational.description: A one-person creative team for your personal brand: interview, content map and drafts in your voice.

demo.name: Creative team
demo.description: Explore a sample brand document, content map and drafts. Nothing is saved and no model runs.

presentation.outcome: Build a brand people can't help but explore: a clear position, months of content ideas through your own lens, and drafts that are almost there.
steps: Answer the intellectual signature questions, by hand or with the brand strategist asking one at a time. The answers become your brand document.
Paste your best posts from each platform, or the 5 to 10 people who shaped your thinking, and note the ideas, voice and worldview behind them.
The content strategist proposes 3 to 4 pillars, 5 to 7 topics each, 5 to 10 ideas per topic and 4 to 5 angles per idea, through your lens.
The writer drafts posts, threads, articles and scripts from the map. You review, rewrite and post them yourself.
presentation.access: Your brand, content and drafts live in this installation's own database. The assistant reads them and proposes changes; nothing is saved until you approve it, and it never posts for you. It does not scrape social platforms: research uses what you paste, its own knowledge and your other Outfitter apps. It uses your organization's or your own inference provider. Demo data is synthetic and read-only.
